title: Final fold: in the last rounds our long dragons travel to the king over a sonar beacon and merge into it
hypothesis: Big-picture phase plan for the round-500 tiebreak (our longest dragon), the reach E0048's merge cascade (+30, kept) lacks. The cascade merges a dragon only when a teammate at least as long reaches its head within P.mergeRadius (2) steps with no enemy in view, so long dragons that are far apart stay separate: champion 602e54e self-play on big_empty (this review, logging copy, unswbc-1.0.0) ended with our three longest at 55, 51 and 49. Rank 1 SSS folds its long dragons into one king at the end: in study replay 133944 (Big Empty, won 70 vs 46) its king (id 210) grew from 41 at r431 to 70 at r499, and from r438 7 of its 9 deaths of length >= 10 (lengths 16, 30, 27, 42, 34, 20, 18) came with the body 1-4 tiles from the king's head, most as noValidAction (a deliberate death). A merged dragon of length L drops ceil(L/2) pearls along its body (docs death.md), so folding the 51 into the 55 is worth up to +26 on the tiebreak, where the median margin is 4-5. Change, one behaviour behind a switch: (1) king beacon: the dragon that is protected (Safety::protectedDragon) adds a gossip record (bot/gossip.hpp, protocol-3 sonar, relayed like the other records) with its head tile, length and round, a fact teammates cannot see for themselves; (2) from P.foldRound (start 430), a dragon that heard a king report within P.kingReportAge (start 10) rounds, is shorter than the reported king, and has time to be eaten (499 - round >= its distance to the king + its length) makes the reported head its target when no pearl is within P.kingPearlReach, and merges through the existing feedDirection once it arrives. The lane decides from a logging copy whether the fold also lifts feedDirection's mergeMinUnits and enemy-in-view gates for folding dragons, and says how often each gate blocked a fold. The king keeps its protection. Scenarios: a length-20 dragon hears a king of 40 twelve tiles away at r440 and walks toward it instead of wandering. Boundary: at r490 a length-20 dragon 15 tiles away keeps eating (it cannot be eaten in time); a report 20 rounds old is ignored; before P.foldRound nothing changes; the king itself never folds. Report per game: longest and total at r499 before and after, folds started and completed, pearls the king ate from each fold, and rounds spent travelling.

title: The fold-window king makes no farm trips on any map size (I457 alone)
hypothesis: General quantity: length our king line loses to its own split-outs from r397 (E0174's 55 champion games v swarm: 384 in 215 splits, 82% after a meal in the king's previous 5 rounds); 90 of 162 farm-entry turns by 16+-long dragons fall on maps of 1024 tiles or fewer, which I441's area gate leaves out. Mechanism alone, behind P.kingFoldSkipsFarms (built in E0197's wip: evaluateMoves' mayFarm = false while kingHoldsSplits): from the fold's start the king refuses closed-pocket farm entries. Scenarios: a king beside a 1-wide dead end with 3 pearls walks past; a non-king folder still farms; a king already inside still splits out when doomed; before the fold nothing changes. Expected small either way (the review's 10 watched trips netted +1.6 against 1.9 of normal intake), so measure changed moves a game first and stop only if under 0.1 a game with the interval wholly below.
